m: 1. क्री cl. 9. P. Ā. क्रीणाति, क्रीणीते (fut. p. क्रेष्यत्, Lāṭy.; ind.p. क्रीत्वा, AV.; Mn.), to buy, purchase (with instr. of the price, and abl. or gen. of the person from whom anything is bought, e.g. क इमम् इन्द्रं दशभिर् धेनुभिर् मम क्रीणाति, who will buy this Indra of me for ten cows? RV. iv, 24, 10; यम् माता-पित्रोर् अन्तिकात् [or सकाशात्] क्रीणीयात् whom he may buy from his father and mother, Mn. ix, 174; क्रीणीष्व तद् दशभिः सुवर्णैह्, buy that for ten suvarṇas) : Caus. P. क्रापयति, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 48;
क्री [cf. Hib. creanaim, ‘I buy, purchase’; Gk. πρίαμαι πέρνημι Lith. prekis, perku (?); Lat. pretium; Eng. hire.]
2. क्री See यव-क्री, सद्यः-क्री
a: क्री — {c9c} U. (क्रीणाति, क्रीणीते, क्रीत) 1 To buy, purchase; महता पुण्यपण्येन क्रीतेयं कायनौस्त्वया Śānti. 3. 1; क्रीणीष्व मज्जीवितमेव पण्यमन्यन्न चेदस्ति तदस्तु पुण्यं N. 3. 87, 88; क्रीणंति स्म प्राणमूल्यैर्यशांसि Śi. 18. 15; Pt. 1. 13; Ms. 9. 174. --2 To barter, exchange; कच्चित्सहस्रैर्मूर्खाणामेकं क्रीणासि पंडितं Mb. --3 To win. [cf. Pers. kharidan].
क्री — a. (At the end of comp.) Buying.

m: क्रीब mfn. = क्लीब accord. to a gloss on KātyŚr. xv, 10, 18.

क्रीड् cl. 1. P. क्रीडति (or क्रीळति, RV.; ep. also Ā.; perf. चिक्रीड, MBh.; fut. p. क्रीडिष्यत्, BhP. iii, 17, 24 ; aor. अक्रीडीत्, Bhaṭṭ.), to play, sport, amuse one's self, frolic, gambol, dally (used of men, animals, the wind and waves, &c.), RV.; VS.; AV. &c.; to jest, joke with (instr. or instr. with सह or सार्धम्; once acc. Mṛcch.), Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.: Caus. क्रीडयति, to cause to play, allow to play, MBh. i, 6440; iv, 329; BhP.
a: क्रीड् — {c1c} P. (क्रीडति, क्रीडित) 1 To play, amuse oneself; वानराः क्रीडितुमारब्धाः Pt. 1; एष क्रीडति कूपयंत्रघटिकान्यायप्रसक्तो विधिः Mk. 10. 59. --2 To gamble, play at dice; बहुविधं द्यूतं क्रीडतः Mk. 2; नाक्षैः क्रीडेत्कदाचिद्धि Ms. 4. 74; Y. 1. 138. --3 To jest, joke or trifle with; सद्वृत्तस्तनमंडलस्तव कथं प्राणैर्मम क्रीडति Gīt. 3; क्रीडिष्यामि तावदेनया V. 3; एवमाशाग्रहग्रस्तैः क्रीडंति धनिनोर्थिभिः H. 2. 23; Pt. 1. 187; Mk. 3. --WITH अनु (Atm.) to play, sport, amuse oneself; साध्वनुक्रीडमानानि पश्य वृंदानि पक्षिणां Bk. 8. 10. --आ, --परि, --सं (Atm.) to play &c.; संक्रीडंते मणिभिर्यत्र कन्याः Me. 67; but क्रीड् with सं is Paras. in the sense of ‘making a noise’; त्वन्नामवर्णा इव कर्णपीता मयास्य संक्रीडति चक्रचक्रे N. 3. 50; संक्रीडंति शकटानि Mbh. ‘the carts creak.’

m: क्रीडा (आ), f. sport, play, pastime, amusement, amorous sport (often in comp., e.g. क्रीडा-मुदः f. pl. the pleasures of playing or of amorous sport, Gīt. ix, 9; कृष्ण-क्˚, sport with Kṛṣṇa, BhP. ii, 3, 15; जल-क्˚, playing about in water, MBh.; Pañcat.; BhP.; तोय-क्˚ id., Megh.), VS. xviii, 5; R.; Suśr. &c.

a play-ground, MBh. iii, 12318
(in music) a kind of measure.
क्रीडा (f. of ˚ड, q.v.)
a: क्रीडा — [क्रीड्-भावे अ] 1 Sport, pastime, play, pleasure, तोयक्रीडानिरतयुवतिस्नानतिक्तैर्मरुद्भिः Me. 33, 61. --2 Jest, joke. --Comp. --आकूतं a sportive purpose. --उद्देशः play ground. --काननं, --वनं a pleasure grove, park. --कोप false or feigned anger; Amaru. 12. --कौतूकं {1} wanton curiosity. {2} sport, play. {3} sexual intercourse. --गृहं, --मंदिरं a pleasure-house. --नारी a prostitute, harlot. --मयूरः a peacock kept for pleasure; R. 16. 14. --मृगः a toy-deer. --रत्नं ‘the gem of sports’, copulation. --वेश्मन् n. a pleasure-house. --शैलः, --पर्वतः an artificial hill serving as a pleasure abode, a pleasure mountain; क्रीडाशैलः कनककदलीवेष्टनप्रेक्षणीयः Me. 77.

k.v: हेला लीलेत्यमी हावाः क्रियाः शृङ्गारभावजाः। द्रवकेलिपरीहासाः क्रीडा लीला च नर्म च॥
व्याजोऽपदेशो लक्ष्यं च क्रीडा खेला च कूर्दनम्. घर्मो निदाघः स्वेदः स्यात्प्रलयो नष्टचेष्टता॥

क्रीडनक—˚तया ind. instr. after the manner of a plaything, BhP. v, 26, 32.
क्रीडनिका f. a nurse who entertains children with plays, Divyāv.
क्रीडत् mfn. playing, sportive, RV.; AV. &c.

v: tri॰ krIqa--in । krIqake । “A krIqayo na mAtaraM tudantaH” f॰ 10 । 94 । 14 ।
m: क्रीडि or क्रीळि, mfn. playing, sporting, RV.; MaitrS. i, 10, 6; (said of the winds), RV. i, 87, 3.
a: क्रीडि — a. Ved. Playing, sporting, (epithet of the wind.)

v: tri॰ krIqa--bA॰ tAcCIlye ini । 1 krIqASIle 2 vAyuBede pu॰ “krIqiByaH saMsfzwAn marudByaH” yaju॰ 24 । 26 “krIqI ca SAkI cAjjezI” yaju॰ 17 । 85 “krIqI sadAkrIqASIlomarut” vedadI॰ ।
m: क्रीडिन् mfn. playing, sporting (said of the winds), VS.; TS. i, 6, 7, 5; ŚBr. ii, 5, 3, 20 (cf. श्व-क्˚)
क्रीडिन् m. N. of a man, Pravar.
क्रीडित mfn. having played, Pañcat.
क्रीडित n. sport, play, MBh. iii, 11067; R. v, 13, 23 and 55.
क्रीडितक See माणवक-क्˚.
क्रीडितृ m. one who sports, player, BhP. i, 13, 40.
क्रीडि-त्व n. the state of one who is sporting, TBr. i, 6, 7, 5.
क्रीडोद्देश m. id., R. ii, 94, 12.

v: tri॰ krIqa un । krIqAkArake । “krIqurmaKo na maMhayuH pavitraM soma! gacCasi” f॰ 9 । 20 । 7
m: क्रीडु or क्रीळु, mfn. playing (Soma), RV. ix, 20, 7.
a: क्रीडु — a. Ved. Playing, moving up (as the Soma).

m: क्रीडु—मत् mfn. id. (flames), x, 3, 5.

s: puM, (krIte kraye anuSayaH paScAttApaH .) dravyaM krItvA paScAdanutApaH । yaTA, -- “krItvA mUlyena yaH paRyaM kretA na bahu manyate । krItAnuSaya ityetat vivAdapadamucyate” ॥ iti yAjYavalkyaH ॥
v: pu॰ krIte kraye anuSayaH । “krayavikrayAnuSayaSca” iti manukte azwAdaSavivAdAntargate vivAdaBede anuSayaSayaSabda 186 pf॰ tadvivftirdfSyA । aDikaM vIramitrodaye darSitaM yaTA “aTa krItAnuSayovyavahArapadam । tatsvarUpamAha nAradaH “krItvA mUlyena yat paRyaM kretA na bahu manyate । krItAnuSaya ityetadvivAdapadasucyate” iti । na bahu manyate--samyagasamyagiti pUrvvaM na vicAryya gfhIta mityarTaH । krItaM parIkzaRIyamityAha vfhaspatiH “parIkzeta svayaM krItamanyezAYca pradarSayet । parIkzitaM bahumataM grahItA na punastyajediti” । anyezAM paRyaguRadozavidAmiti SezaH । nArado'pi “kretA paRyaM parIkzeta prAk svayaM guRadozataH । parIkzyABimataM krItaM vikreturna Bavetpunariti” । carmAdInAM parIkzA sadyaH kAryA taTA ca vyAsaH “carmmakAzWezwakAsUtraDAnyAsavarasasya ca । vasukupyahiraRyAnAM sadya eva parIkzaRamiti” । atra vasuSabdena rUpyaM gfhyate । kupyaM rUpyahemavyatiriktaM trapusIsAdikam । taTA ca hemarUpye prastutyAhAmarasiMhaH “tAByAM yadanyattatkupyamiti” । krItapaRyadravyaviSezeRa parIkzaRakAlAvaDimAha BAradaH “tryahAddohyaM parIkzeta paYcAhAdvAhyameva tu । muktAvajraprabAlAnAM saptAhaM syAtparIkzaRam । dvipadAmardDvanAsantu puMsAntaddviguRaM striyAH । daSAhaM sarvavIjAnAmekAhaM lohavAsasAm । ato'rvAkpaRyadozastu yadi saYjAyate kvacit । vikretuH pratideyaM tat kretA mUlyamavApnuyAditi” । tryahAt krayadinAdAraByeti SezaH । paYcAhAdityAdAvapyevameva Sezo'vagantamyaH । tryahaM vikretfpratideyamityAdiviDidarSanAt tryahAddohyamityAdi parIkzaRaM prItidohyAdidavyavizayamiti gamyate iti smfti candrikA । dohyaM mahizyAdikam vAhyaM balIvardAdikam । muktAgrahaRaM ratnopalakzaRam । dvipadAmpuMsAndAsAnAmityarTaH । taddviguRaM mAsAdityarTaH striyAdAsyAityarTaH । pUrvvodAhftacarmmakAzWetyAdivyAsavacanena BakzaRAdyarTaM gfhItAnAM DAnyAdInAM sadyaHparIkzaRABiDAnAt sarvavIjAnAmityatra vIjaSabdovfdDyarTaM gfhItaDAnyaparaH । anyaTA sadyaHparIkzyatvapratipAdakavyAsavacanaviroDaH syAt । ato'rvAk tryahAderaByantara ityarTaH । kAtyAyano'pi “BUmerdaSAho'nuSayaH kreturvikretureva ceti” । BUmergfhakzetrAdirUpAyA anuSayaH parAvarttanayogyaH kAlaH parIkzAkAla iti yAvat । yaToktaparIkzAkAlAtikrame doza darSane na pratidAnamityAha sa eva “avijYAtantu yat krItaM duzwaM paScAdviBAvitam । krItantat svAmine deyampaRyaM kAle'nyaTA na tviti” । avijYAtaM parIkzASETilyAttattvato'parijYAtam । duzwaM viBAbitaM dozavattayA jYAtamityarTaH । kAle parIkzAkAle । anyaTA tatkAlAtyaye duzwatayA pariBAvitamapi tat svAmine na deyam । avijYAtantu yatkrItamityanena yat krayAt prAk aparIkzya krItantat parIkzAsamaye dozadarSane parAvarttanIyam । yattuparokzya gfhItaM tanna parAvarttanIyamiti । darSitamarTaM nAradaAha “krItvA nAnuSayaM kuryyAdbaRikpaRyavicakzaRaH । kzayaM vfdDiYca jAnIyAt paRyAnAmAgamantaTA । kretA paRyaM parIkzeta prAk svayaM guRadozataH । parIkzyABimataM krItaM vikreturna Bavet punariti” । anuSayaM paScAttApam । paRyAnAM aSvAdInAM asmindeSe mUlyahAnirasmindeSe tadADikyamiti kzayavfdDI etaddeSasamBavamityAgamaYca krayAt prAgeva jAnIyAdityarTaH । dozadarSanamantareRa parIkzAkAla eva pratyarpaRe viSezamAha kAtyAyanaH “krItvA cAnuSayaM paScAt tyajeddozAdfte naraH । ajuzwameva kAle tu sa mUlyAddaSamaM bahet । krItvA gacCannanuSayaM krayI hastamupAgate । zadBAgantasya mUlyasya dattvA krItaM tyajennaraH” iti । ajuzwamanaBiBuktam । kAle parIkzAkAle atra mUlyadaSamaBAgadAnaM yadupaBujyamAnamapi na naSyati BUmyAdikaM tadvizayam upaBogavinaSvaravIjAdivizayaM zaq BAgadAnamiti vyavasTA jYeyA । nanu vijAnatA'pyanuSayo na kAryaH “krItvA nAnuSayam kuryyAditi” nizeDasadBAvAditi cetsatyaM apavAdasya sattvAt sa cApavAdodarSito nAradena “krItvA mUlyena yatpaRyaM duzkrItaM manyate krayI । vikretuH pratideyaM tattasminnevAhnyavikzatamiti” । manyata ityanena vastuto dozABAva uktaH । dvitIyAdidivase pratyarpaRe viSezamAha sa eva “dvitIye'hni dadat kretA mUlyAttriMSAMSamAharet । dviguRaM tu tftIye'hni parataH ketureva taditi” । parataH tftIyAhAt parataH kretureva tat krItvA anuSayAdikaM na kuryyAdityarTaH । yattu manuvacanam “krItvA vikrIya vA kiYcidyasyehAnuSayo Bavet । so'ntardarSAhAttaddravyaM dadyAccEvAdadIta veti” tadupaBoge naSvaraCatragfhayAnaSayanAdivizayam । yattU paBogena vikAraprApitaM sadozasapi tat parIkzAkAlamaDye'pi na pratideyamityAha nAradaH “pariBuktantu tadvAsaH kfzRarUpaM malImasam । sadozamapi tat krItaM vikreturna Bavetpunariti” । vAsograhaRamupalakzaRamiti madanaratne । vAsovizayatEvAsyoti mADavIye । paRyAnAM deSakAle upacayApacayO jYAtavyAvityAha nAradaH “kzayaM vfdDiYca jAnIyAtpaRyAnAmAgamantaTeti” । aSvAdipaRyAnAmasmin kAle'smindeSe ca kzayaM vfdDiM vA jAnIyAttaTAgamaM kulInatvAdijYAnArTam utpAdakajanmaBUmyAdikaYca jAnIyAdityarTaH । krayakAle mUlyakzayavfdDidozadarSanamantareRa krotavikrItayoH patyarpaRe punargrahaRe daRqamAha yAjYavalkAH “vfdDiM kzayaM vA baRijA paRyAnAmavijAnatA । krItvA nAnuSayaH kAryyaH kurvat zawBAgadaRqaBAgiti” । vfdDiM mUlyavfdDim avijAnatA kretrA evaM mUlyakzayamavijAnatA vikretretyarTaH । parIkzAkAlAtikrameRa pratyarpaRe daRqamAha manuH “grahaRe tu daSAhasya na dadyAnnApi dApayet । AdadAno dadaccEva rAjYA daRWyaH SatAni zaqiti” । daSAhagrahaRaM parIkzAkAlasya pUrvvoktasyopalakzaRam । sarvametatpariBAzaRamfte pariBAzaRa tu tadanusAreREva pratidAnaM tadaBAvAdikaM mantavyam” । krayAnuSayo'pyatra ।
m: क्रीतानुशय m. repenting a purchase, returning a purchase upon the seller (admissible in some cases by law).
क्रीता-पति m. the husband of a wife acquired by purchase, Nir. vi, 9.

s: puM, (krI + karmmaRi ktaH .) krItakaputtraH । sa tu dvAdaSaviDaputtrAntargataputtraBedaH । iti jawADaraH ॥ (yaTAha, yAjYavalkyaH । “dadyAt mAtApitA vA yaM sa puttro dattako Bavet । krItaSca tAByAM vikrItaH kftrimaH syAt svayaM kftaH” ॥) kftakraye tri । kenA iti BAzA । yaTA, -- “dIyamAnaM na gfhRAti krItaM paRyantu yaH krayI । sa evAsya Baveddozo vikreturyo'prayacCataH” ॥ iti prAyaScittatattve nAradaH ॥
v: tri॰ krI--karmmaRi kta । 1 mUlyadAnena svatvAspadIBUte kfte । “SUdrAnItEH krayakrItEH (jalEH) karmma kurvvan patatyaDaH” smftiH । 2 gORaputraBede pu॰ । “krItaSca navamaH sayena krItaH” vizRu MsaM॰ । BAve kta । 3 kraye na॰ krItAnuSayaH । putraBedAstallakzaRAni ca yogISvareRa darSitAni yaTA “Oraso DarmmapatnIjastatsamaH putrikAsutah । kzetrajaH kzetrajAtastu sagotreRetareRa vA । gfhe pracCanna utpanno gUQajastu sutaH smftaH । kAnInaH kanyakAjAto mAtAmahasutomataH । akzatAyAM kzatAyAM vA jAtaH pOna rBavaH sutaH । dadyAnmAtA pitA vA yaM sa putrodattako Bavet । krItaSca tAByAM vikrItaH, kftrimaH syAt svayaMkftaH । dattAtmA tu svayandattI garBe vinnaH sahoqajaH । ut sfzwo gfhyate yastu so'pavidDoBavet sutaH” । “adUrabAnDavamiti deSaBAzAviprakfzwasya pratizeDaH evaM krItasvayandattakftrimezvapi yojyaM samAnanyAyatvAt । krItastu vikrItaH mAtApitfByAM pUrvvavat taTEkaM putraM jyezWaYca varjayitvA Apadi । savarRa ityeva yattu manunoktam “krIRIyAdyastvapatyArTaM mAtApitroryamantikAt । sa krItakaH sutastasya sadfSo'sadfSopi'veti” tadguREH sadfSo'sadfSo veti vyAKyeyaM na YAtyA “sajAtIyezvayamproktastanayezu maryA viDiH” ityupa saMhArAt” mitA॰ । svArTe ka । tatrArTe । “kAnInaSca sahoQaSca krItaH pOnarBavastaTA । svayaM dattaSca SOdraSca zaqadAyAdabAnDavAH” iti manUkteH tasya pivfmAvfBinnadAyAnaDikAritvam । dattakarmAmAMsAmate “OrasaH kzetrajaScEva dattaH kftrima ca” parASareRa kaliDarmmaprastAve caturRRAmeva grAhyatAyA ukteH dattakacakAmate “dattOrasetarezAYca putratvena parigrahaH” ityAdi purARe dattOrasaBinnAnAM kalO varjyatvokteSca krItaputrasya na kalO karttavyatA ।
m: क्रीत mfn. bought, purchased, ŚBr.; Mn. &c.
purchased from his natural parents (as a son; one of the twelve kinds of sons acknowledged by the ancient Hindū law), Mn. ix, 160
won by (instr.), Śak. iii (v.l.)
ifc. (with the purchase-price; f(ई). ), Pāṇ. iv, 1, 50; vi, 2, 151
क्रीत mf(आ or ई)n. (f. also आ), Siddh.
क्रीत (अस्), m. N. of a man, MaitrS. iv, 2, 6
क्रीत (आस्), m. pl. a sort of despised caste, W.
क्रीत (अम्), n. a bargain Comm. on Yājñ. ii, 6.
क्रीत &c. See √ क्री.
a: क्रीत — p. p. Bought; see क्री. --तः One of the twelve kinds of sons recognised in Hindu Law; a son purchased from his natural parents; क्रीतश्च ताभ्यां विक्रीतः Y. 2. 131. --Comp. --अनुशयः ‘repenting a purchase’, rescission, returning a thing purchased to the seller (admissible in some cases by law).

s: puM, (krIta + svArTe kan .) krItaputtraH । yaTA, manuH । 9 । 174 । “krIRIyAdyastvapatyArTaM mAtApitroryamantikAt । sa krItakaH sutastasya sadfSo'sadfSo'pi vA” ॥
m: क्रीतक mfn. bought from his natural parents (and adopted as male issue), Mn. ix, 174; Pravar.
a: क्रीतक — a. Got by purchase. --कः A son bought from his parents and adopted; Ms. 9. 174. cf. क्रीत above.

m: क्रीत—त्व n. the being bought, Jaim. vi, 1, 19.
